sloka: दुन्धुभिस्वनकल्पेन गम्भीरेणानुनादिना ।स्वरेण महता राजा जीमूत इव नादयन् ॥२-२-२॥
transliteration: dundhubhisvanakalpena gambhīreṇānunādinā ।svareṇa mahatā rājā jīmūta iva nādayan ॥2-2-2॥

translations.english: ﻿ Lord of men (king Dasaratha) addressed the feudatory kings with words deep, resonant, loud like the kettledrum or the rumbling cloud, in a delightful, incomparable and attractive voice that carried all the dignity of royalty:
